text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Tumor of the Bone (GCTB) of the distal femur.

The X-ray showing a lytic lesion with a "soap bubble" appearance and thin cortical rim, combined with your age and severe, night-disrupting pain, is classic for this diagnosis. Given the normal inflammatory markers and the specific radiographic features, this is likely a benign but locally aggressive bone tumor. I recommend preparing for a biopsy to confirm the diagnosis and plan for surgical intervention.
